dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductive family indexed by nine natural numbers. Through constructor D015, an inhabitant packages dimensions and their factorizations, two real matrices, input perturbations, five real error parameters, and one modeled computation for every output entry.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified run is an inhabitant of this family, so all data and admissibility conditions packaged by its constructor restrict the computations to which the bound applies.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts from a run its function A : Fin m → Fin n → Real, interpreted as an m-by-n real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A appears in both the exact matrix-product entry and the componentwise magnitude sum on the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts from a run its function B : Fin n → Fin t → Real, interpreted as an n-by-t real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: B appears in both the exact matrix-product entry and the componentwise magnitude sum on the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: For output indices i and j, returns the computed field of the corresponding entry run; by D013 this is that entry run's state at natural index q.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the computed scalar whose absolute error is bounded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the global real parameter uBar from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: uBar enters the effective error selector, gamma_n(uBar), the admissibility condition n uBar < 1, and the internal entry-run error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the global real parameter uFma from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: uFma enters the piecewise effective error parameter and is constrained to equal either uLow or uHigh.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the global real parameter uLow from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: uLow bounds both input perturbation arrays and appears explicitly in the coefficient 2 uLow + uLow² and in the factor (1 + uLow)².

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the global real parameter uOut from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: uOut enters the piecewise effective error parameter used in gamma_q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices A and B, defines the nonnegative componentwise magnitude product S_ij = ∑_{k ∈ Fin n} |A_ik| |B_kj|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: S_ij multiplies the complete error coefficient on the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: For real a and u and naturals q and n, defines gamma_q(a) + gamma_n(u) + gamma_q(a) gamma_n(u), where gamma_s(v) = s v / (1 - s v).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With a equal to the piecewise effective error and u equal to uBar, this supplies the combined internal-error coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines phi(uBar,uFma,uOut) piecewise: phi = uOut if uFma < uOut; otherwise phi = 0 if uFma ≤ uBar; otherwise phi = uFma.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This phi is the first argument of the combined gamma expression and is also the per-block delta bound within every entry run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the exact real matrix-product entry (AB)_ij = ∑_{k ∈ Fin n} A_ik B_kj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This exact quantity is subtracted from the modeled computed result inside the absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an entry run with q blocks, defines its computed value to be state(q).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the target's computed entry with the final modeled recurrence state after q block steps.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the family entryRun : Fin m → Fin t → LocalDef018 n b q from a global run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the modeled scalar computation associated with each output entry i,j.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a global run from positive naturals m,n,t,b1,b,b2,p,q,r satisfying m = p b1, n = q b, and t = r b2; matrices A and B; input-error arrays; nonnegative parameters uLow,uHigh,uBar,uFma,uOut satisfying uHigh ≤ uLow, uFma = uLow or uFma = uHigh, uBar ≤ uFma, q phi < 1, and n uBar < 1; entrywise input-error bounds by uLow; and a family of entry runs whose local parameters equal the global ones and whose x and y values are A and B multiplied by 1 plus the corresponding input errors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This constructor supplies all global hypotheses hidden in the run binder. It restricts dimensions, perturbations, error parameters, and the relationship between each modeled entry computation and A,B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines gamma_n(u) = n u / (1 - n u), with n cast from Nat to Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines gamma_q(phi) and gamma_n(uBar) in the final coefficient and the gamma bounds imposed on internal entry-run errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the stability predicate on u and n as n u < 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires q phi < 1 and n uBar < 1, ensuring the two gamma denominators in the target coefficient are positive.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductive family representing one modeled blocked inner-product computation with inner dimension n, block size b, and block count q. Constructor D026 packages its recurrence and all local error witnesses and bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each computed output entry is state(q) from such an inhabitant, so its possible value is restricted by the recurrence and error-model hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the state function Nat → Real from an entry run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The computed result is state(q), and the constructor constrains state(0) and every transition state(k) to state(k+1).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts an entry run's local uBar parameter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The global constructor requires this local value to equal the global uBar.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts an entry run's local uFma parameter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The global constructor requires this local value to equal the global uFma.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts an entry run's local uOut parameter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The global constructor requires this local value to equal the global uOut.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the block-indexed input x : Fin q → Fin b → Real from an entry run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For output entry i,j, the global constructor fixes x_kl to A_i,lambda(k,l) multiplied by 1 plus the corresponding input error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the block-indexed input y : Fin q → Fin b → Real from an entry run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For output entry i,j, the global constructor fixes y_kl to B_lambda(k,l),j multiplied by 1 plus the corresponding input error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given n = q b, maps a block index k ∈ Fin q and within-block index l ∈ Fin b to the index lambda(k,l) ∈ Fin n obtained from the finite-product equivalence; numerically its value is l + b k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies exactly how the q-by-b blocked inputs x and y are drawn from the n inner indices of A and B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an entry run under 0 < n,b,q, n = q b, nonnegative uBar,uFma,uOut, uBar ≤ uFma, q phi < 1, and n uBar < 1. It packages x,y, an opaque order mode, state, carryTheta, termTheta, delta, and path-error witnesses. It requires state(0)=0 and state(k+1) = (state(k)(1+carryTheta_k) + ∑_l x_kl y_kl(1+termTheta_kl))(1+delta_k). It bounds |delta_k| by phi, |carryTheta_k| by gamma_b(uBar), and |termTheta_kl| by gamma_b(uBar) for k=0 and gamma_{b+1}(uBar) otherwise. In the distinguished D029 mode it additionally bounds carryTheta by gamma_1(uBar) and requires a second path-error representation. In all modes it requires bounded n-factor path errors whose product equals (1+termTheta_kl) times the later-carry product.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These recurrence, bound, and factorization requirements define the admissible modeled computed values even though they do not appear syntactically in the final inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given n = q b, constructs an equivalence between Fin q × Fin b and Fin n by first using the standard product-index equivalence and then casting Fin(q b) to Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the blocked-to-linear index map used in D025.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: An opaque order-mode type with a distinguished nullary constructor D029, another nullary constructor D032, and a Nat-indexed constructor family D033.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: An entry run carries one such mode. Equality with D029 activates additional carry and right-to-left path constraints.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished nullary value of the order-mode type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: When an entry run's order equals this value, the tighter gamma_1 carry bound and the right-to-left path-error conditions are required.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: States symmetry of the dimension equality: from n = q b it derives q b = n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports casting Fin(q b) to Fin n in the blocked-index equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: For carry errors indexed by Fin q, defines the later-carry factor at k as ∏_{l=k+1}^{q-1} (1 + carryTheta_l), with the empty product equal to 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This factor occurs in the path-product identities constraining termTheta and carryTheta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: A second nullary order-mode value, distinct from D029.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For this mode the implications conditioned on equality with D029 impose no additional constraints.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: A family of order-mode values indexed by a natural number, each distinct from the nullary constructors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For these modes the implications conditioned on equality with D029 impose no additional constraints.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extends a function error : Fin q → Real to natural indices by returning error(k) when k < q and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It lets the later-carry product be written over a natural-number interval; on its actual interval every index is below q.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the type of natural numbers strictly less than n.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the power operation supplied by an HPow instance.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the subtraction operation supplied by an HSub instance.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow

dependency_coverage.name: Nat

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides evidence that n+1 is at least two when n is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass machinery used to interpret the real numeral 2 and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides evidence that every natural successor is nonzero.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a type with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real constants 1 and 2 and the natural constants used in dimensions and exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Derives interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each real occurrence of 1 the ordinary real number one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The mathematical type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Matrices, perturbations, states, parameters, exact quantities, and bounds are all real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary addition on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines all real additions in the coefficient, sums, perturbation factors, and recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the additive-group structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real negation needed by absolute value and supports the usual additive algebra.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the ordinary less-than-or-equal relation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the final comparison and every non-strict real inequality to their standard meanings.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural powers of real numbers, including the two squares in the coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines all scalar products in the exact product, magnitude sum, coefficient, recurrence, and path identities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the canonical embedding of natural numbers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets q, n, b, and other natural factors as real scalars in gamma expressions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the multiplicative identity 1 in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines all factors of the form 1 plus an error.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines real subtraction as addition of the additive inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the usual computed-minus-exact difference and gamma denominators.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the lattice order structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the additive group it permits the standard absolute-value operation.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines absolute value as max(a,-a) in a lattice-ordered additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it is ordinary scalar absolute value, used for the final error, matrix magnitudes, and all modeled-error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns a homogeneous Add operation into an HAdd operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures every homogeneous real or natural HAdd expression uses the corresponding ordinary addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns a homogeneous Mul operation into an HMul operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures every homogeneous real or natural HMul expression uses the corresponding ordinary multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns a power operation into the corresponding homogeneous HPow operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects real natural exponentiation to the square expressions in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns a homogeneous Sub operation into an HSub operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures real subtraction and natural truncated subtraction have their ordinary meanings.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural literal at least two through the target type's natural-number cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the coefficient's numeral 2 as the real number two.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets each natural-number literal as itself in Nat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural constants such as 0, 1, and 2 used in indices, dimensions, and exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the finite enumeration of Fin n by the values 0 through n-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It allows sums and products over all matrix, block, and path indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forms the finite sum of a function over a finite set in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it defines exact matrix-product sums, magnitude sums, and block sums in the state recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Fin n or Fin b it makes sums and products range over every valid index exactly once.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the strict-order relation supplied by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses positivity of natural dimensions, real stability inequalities, and the branch uFma < uOut.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.decidableLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decides each proposition a ≤ b for real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the second branch test in the piecewise effective error executable without changing its mathematical meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.decidableLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decides each proposition a < b for real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the first branch test in the piecewise effective error executable without changing its mathematical meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the additive commutative-monoid structure of Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It validates finite real sums and gives the empty sum value zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the ordinary strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes all strict real inequalities, including q phi < 1 and n uBar < 1, to their standard meanings.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the additive identity 0 in Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets nonnegativity conditions, state(0)=0, and the zero branch of the effective error.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Derives interpretation of the numeral 0 from a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes real occurrences of 0 the ordinary real zero.

dependency_coverage.name: ite
dependency_coverage.meaning: A nondependent if-then-else expression selected by a decidable proposition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the branches of phi and the choice between gamma_b and gamma_{b+1} in the term-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts division from a division-and-inverse monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real division in gamma_n(u) = n u / (1 - n u).

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states dimension factorizations, parameter choices and identifications, recurrence equations, path-product identities, and tests whether the order is the distinguished mode.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the division operation supplied by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it denotes ordinary division in every gamma expression.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Casts a natural number into a type with a NatCast instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns natural dimensions into real multipliers in stability predicates and gamma functions.

dependency_coverage.name: Or
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical disjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires uFma to equal uLow or to equal uHigh.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies multiplication, inversion, and division on Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the standard real division used by gamma functions.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns a homogeneous Div operation into an HDiv operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the standard real division operation to the gamma definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the ordinary strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets dimension positivity, finite-index bounds, and natural interval tests.

dependency_coverage.name: instMulNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary multiplication on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets m = p b1, n = q b, t = r b2, and the blocked-index formula.

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe
dependency_coverage.meaning: Coerces a function-like object to its underlying dependent function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is implementation machinery for applying the finite-index equivalence in D025.

dependency_coverage.name: Equiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: A bijective correspondence between two types, represented by mutually inverse functions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents the bijection between blocked pairs Fin q × Fin b and linear indices Fin n.

dependency_coverage.name: Equiv.instEquivLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: Makes an equivalence usable as a bijective function-like object.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits evaluation of the blocked-index equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: EquivLike.toFunLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets inverse data from an equivalence-like object and exposes its forward function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports applying and composing the blocked-index equivalences.

dependency_coverage.name: Prod
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Cartesian product type of ordered pairs.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It pairs a block index with a within-block index before conversion to Fin n.

dependency_coverage.name: Prod.mk
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an ordered pair.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the pair (k,l) supplied to the blocked-index equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: Equiv.trans
dependency_coverage.meaning: Composes two equivalences.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It composes the standard Fin q × Fin b to Fin(q b) map with the cast from Fin(q b) to Fin n.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the underlying natural number from a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies numerical indices for state transitions, branch tests, intervals, and the linear index l + b k.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.prod
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forms the finite product of a function over a finite set in a commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines later-carry factors and both families of path-error product identities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the commutative multiplicative monoid structure of Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It validates finite real products and gives the empty product value one.

dependency_coverage.name: finCongr
dependency_coverage.meaning: An equality n = m induces an equivalence Fin n ≃ Fin m by casting indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It converts Fin(q b) to Fin n using the dimension equality.

dependency_coverage.name: finProdFinEquiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard equivalence Fin q × Fin b ≃ Fin(q b), mapping (k,l) to the index with value l + b k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the exact row-major linearization used for blocked matrix inputs.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets k+1, b+1, q+b, and the linear index l+b k.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decides equality of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It decides whether a block index has value zero in the termTheta bound.

dependency_coverage.name: instSubNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies truncated subtraction on natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.Ico
dependency_coverage.meaning: For natural endpoints a and b, gives the finite half-open interval {a,a+1,...,b-1}.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instLocallyFiniteOrder

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instPreorder

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.mk

binders: A packaged run of type LocalDef001 m n t b1 b b2 p q r.
An output row index i ∈ Fin m and output column index j ∈ Fin t.
hypotheses: The run packages strict positivity of all nine natural parameters and the dimension factorizations m = p b1, n = q b, and t = r b2.
The run packages real matrices A ∈ Real^(m×n) and B ∈ Real^(n×t), together with input-error arrays eA and eB satisfying |eA_ik| ≤ uLow and |eB_kj| ≤ uLow for all valid indices.
The real parameters uLow,uHigh,uBar,uFma,uOut are nonnegative; uHigh ≤ uLow; uFma equals either uLow or uHigh; and uBar ≤ uFma.
With phi = uOut when uFma < uOut, phi = 0 when uFma is not below uOut and uFma ≤ uBar, and phi = uFma otherwise, the stability conditions q phi < 1 and n uBar < 1 hold.

For every output entry i,j there is a modeled entry run whose local uBar,uFma,uOut equal the global values and whose blocked inputs satisfy x_kl = A_i,lambda(k,l)(1+eA_i,lambda(k,l)) and y_kl = B_lambda(k,l),j(1+eB_lambda(k,l),j), where lambda(k,l) has value l+b k.
Each entry run has state(0)=0 and, for every k ∈ Fin q, state(k+1) = (state(k)(1+carryTheta_k) + ∑_{l ∈ Fin b} x_kl y_kl(1+termTheta_kl))(1+delta_k).
The recurrence errors satisfy |delta_k| ≤ phi, |carryTheta_k| ≤ gamma_b(uBar), and |termTheta_kl| ≤ gamma_b(uBar) when k=0 and ≤ gamma_{b+1}(uBar) otherwise.

Each entry run additionally carries bounded path-error witnesses whose products equal (1+termTheta_kl)∏_{s=k+1}^{q-1}(1+carryTheta_s). In the distinguished order mode D029, it also satisfies |carryTheta_k| ≤ gamma_1(uBar) and an additional right-to-left path-error product representation with q+b-1 factors.
conclusions: For every i ∈ Fin m and j ∈ Fin t, |computed_ij - ∑_{k ∈ Fin n} A_ik B_kj| ≤ [2 uLow + uLow² + (gamma_q(phi) + gamma_n(uBar) + gamma_q(phi) gamma_n(uBar))(1+uLow)²] ∑_{k ∈ Fin n} |A_ik| |B_kj|.
mathematical_definitions: Fin s is the index set {0,1,...,s-1}.
lambda(k,l) is the element of Fin n with underlying value l+b k, using n=q b.
gamma_s(u) = s u / (1 - s u), with s interpreted as a real number.
phi(uBar,uFma,uOut) = uOut if uFma < uOut; otherwise phi = 0 if uFma ≤ uBar; otherwise phi = uFma.
The exact entry is P_ij = (AB)_ij = ∑_{k=0}^{n-1} A_ik B_kj.
The componentwise magnitude quantity is S_ij = ∑_{k=0}^{n-1} |A_ik| |B_kj|.
The modeled computed entry is computed_ij = state_ij(q).
The final coefficient is C = 2 uLow + uLow² + Gamma(1+uLow)².
Thus the conclusion is the componentwise scalar bound |computed_ij-P_ij| ≤ C S_ij; no matrix norm occurs.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every admissible blocked matrix-product run and every output entry, the absolute error between the modeled computed value after q block steps and the exact real matrix-product entry is at most the componentwise magnitude sum ∑|A_ik||B_kj| multiplied by 2 uLow + uLow² plus the combined gamma factor [gamma_q(phi)+gamma_n(uBar)+gamma_q(phi)gamma_n(uBar)] times (1+uLow)².

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: All substantive hypotheses are hidden inside the run object. For parameter choices or data for which no such run can be constructed, the universal implication is vacuously true.
The run forces all dimensions and block counts to be positive and exactly factored as m=p b1, n=q b, and t=r b2.
The conditions q phi < 1 and n uBar < 1, together with nonnegativity, make the two gamma denominators occurring in the conclusion positive.
The theorem is componentwise and uses scalar absolute value; it does not state a matrix-norm bound.
The result compares against the exact product of the unperturbed matrices A and B, although the recurrence consumes multiplicatively perturbed inputs x and y.
The parameters b1,b2,p,r affect admissibility and dimension factorization but do not occur in the displayed error coefficient.
The order-mode constructors have no supplied intended interpretation. Only their structural effect is encoded: extra conditions apply exactly in the distinguished D029 mode.
For modes other than D029, the right-to-left path-error arguments are packaged but their conditional bounds and product identities impose no restriction.
The path-error witnesses and product identities are strong existence requirements and are another possible source of vacuity.
The state function is constrained at indices 0 through q by the recurrence; values after q are irrelevant to the proposition.
No assumptions about floating-point overflow, underflow, subnormal values, exceptional values, rounding modes, probability, or a concrete hardware implementation are encoded.
The names uLow, uHigh, uBar, uFma, and uOut do not themselves add semantics beyond the explicitly stated equations and inequalities; notably the encoded relation is uHigh ≤ uLow.
No sign or magnitude restrictions are imposed on entries of A or B.
If S_ij = 0, the conclusion forces computed_ij to equal the exact product entry at that position.
ambiguities: The intended algorithmic meanings of the three forms of LocalDef028 are not supplied. The exact proposition can only identify D029 as the distinguished mode that activates additional hypotheses.
